text:
sam: Heads-up: noticing intermittent packet loss (~0.5-1.8%) on the overlay (Geneve) inside us-east-2 GPU cluster (gpu-pool-8) since ~09:10 UTC. gRPC between model-workers -> inference-proxy showing retries/timeouts. Anyone else?

maya: Yep — dashboards show retransmit spikes and p99 tail latency up. Affected pods spread across 3 AZs in that region.

devon: Any big churn or autoscaling events? We had a few batch jobs finish around then but no large node churn reported.

sam: Checked node lifecycle events — nothing notable. kubelet logs look normal.

net-bot: quick check: ran `mtr -r -c 50 10.32.45.12` from a worker -> overlay IP shows intermittent 1-2% packet loss and occasional 100-200ms RTTs. Host eth0 path shows ~0% loss.

henry: This smells like geneve offload/gso/tso regression on newer kernel/driver combo. Recall last week we had a similar surface with RDMA NICs when GENEVE/encap offloads were enabled. Can we try disabling offloads on a couple canary nodes?

maya: I'll run a canary. Commands I'll use: `sudo ethtool -K <if> gro off gso off tso off rx off tx off` on the node's host interfaces and then bounce the pod NICs. Also will verify `ip link show` MTU matches (should be 8950 across host+geneve).

devon: Also saw a couple `Fragmentation needed but DF set` messages in kube-proxy logs — worth double-checking MTU end-to-end and any host mtu overrides in bootstrap.

sam: Good catch. If offload disable fixes it, we can decide whether to roll a kernel fix or apply a daemonset that sets offloads until upstream patch lands. Created INC-2026 to track. Tagging oncall: @henry

henry: I'm oncall — will take two GPU nodes from pool-8 as canaries at 11:00 UTC. Plan: 1) cordon & drain pods 2) run `ethtool -K` offload disable 3) restart affected pods (force recreate) 4) run `mtr` + `tcpdump` and gather `tc -s qdisc` and `ss -t` stats. Posting logs here.

ops-bot: FYI: routing fallback policy available — we can route inference traffic to dedicated-inference-s1 if degradation persists beyond 30m. That will increase cost but preserve SLAs.

net-bot: Update 11:23 UTC: on canary nodes with offloads disabled, retransmits fell to ~0.1%, p99 latency decreased ~30%. Still monitoring for 30m.

maya: Nice. I'll prepare a quick DaemonSet that flips offloads for gpu nodes and a runbook entry (networking/geneve-offload-mitigation). Will also add MTU validation to node bootstrap.

sam: Great — once we watch the canary window we'll update INC-2026 and decide next steps (daemonset vs kernel roll). Thanks all :thumbsup:
